title: Dora's Dandelions
description: Dora's dandelion recipe features fresh greens tossed in a hot, vinegary, bacon dressing. Serve over boiled potatoes for a springtime vegetable dish.
ingredients: 5 pounds white potatoes, peeled and cubed

steps.text: Place potatoes in a large pot and cover with salted water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Drain, toss with butter, and season with salt and black pepper. Keep warm.
Cook bacon in a large, deep skillet over medium-high heat until evenly brown. Drain on paper towels. Set aside skillet with bacon drippings.
Gently toss dandelion greens and onion together in a large bowl until combined; set aside.

Whisk vinegar, egg, and sugar together in a small bowl; season with salt and black pepper. Stir egg mixture into warm bacon drippings in the skillet; stir in bacon and flour. Whisk until thickened to the consistency of salad dressing, about 1 minute. Immediately pour over dandelion-onion mixture; toss to coat.
